title: J. Storrs Hall's utility fog

tellings.quote: In 1989, scientist Dr. J. Storrs Hall >> [music] pitched the concept of utility fog, an active polymorphic material made up of trillions of foglets

plain: In 1989, according to Michels, a scientist named J. Storrs Hall proposed "utility fog": a material made of trillions of tiny robots called "foglets" that could link together and change shape into almost anything. Michels tells it in his own narration, without naming a source, and places the idea at a NASA conference. He raises it as a model for how a strange, shape-shifting object might really be built.
